A '''poison resevoir''' was a modification to a bladed weapon. It was a small tank of poison was connected by a channel to the tip of the blade. Poison reservoirs sold for 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
